name: Spherical Harmonics Evaluation
definition: Computes the RGB color of a Gaussian from its Spherical Harmonics (SH) coefficients and a viewing direction vector. It handles SH degrees 0, 1, 2, and optionally 3.
summary: Spherical Harmonics Evaluation computes view-dependent RGB colors by projecting stored SH coefficients onto viewing directions, differing from initialization or rotation by performing final color computation.
